claims.citation: New York Herald, 9 June 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Brig Laura (of Antigua), Leonard, Rio Janeiro, 37 days,
with coffee, to Jas Patrick & Co. 4th inst, lat 32 08, lon 68
13, spoke bark Omega, from Palermo for New York, 37 days
out; 6th, lat 35 50, lon 72 20, brig Paragon, from Anguilla for
Portland.
